panels.title: Client redirects / s
panels.description: Client redirect demand from r-stream (all opcodes). Independent of OpenVerify.

panels.title: Open-read / s
panels.description: Client open-read redirect rate (opcode=openr).

panels.title: Locate / s
panels.description: Client locate redirect rate (opcode=locate).

panels.title: Distinct dest hosts
panels.description: Distinct redirect destination hosts seen since collector start (per-instance sum).

panels.title: Active cmsd peers
panels.description: Count of cmsd subscribed peers whose run status includes active (a).

panels.title: Redirects by type
panels.description: Client redirect rates by opcode (locate, openr, …).

panels.title: Redirects by destination
panels.description: Top-15 site gateways by client redirect rate.

panels.title: Redirects per destination (rate)
panels.description: Sortable destination host list (ops triage / capacity).

panels.title: cmsd peer liveness
panels.description: Per cmsd peer: active bit from summary run flags (a = active).

panels.title: Collector parse errors / s
panels.description: UDP parse failures in the local metrics collector.

panels.title: OV redirects handled / s
panels.description: OpenVerify-handled redirect hops (not raw client AAA demand).

panels.title: Verify failure rate
panels.description: runs_total failure / runs_total — only hops that actually executed open_verify. Excludes FIFO queue_timeout / queue_full (see Queue reject / s).

panels.title: Queue reject / s
panels.description: Leaders rejected by FIFO before open_verify (queue_timeout + queue_full). Not counted in runs_total / verify_failures_total.

panels.title: Unhealthy sites
panels.description: Count of sites with site_healthy=0 (EWMA quarantine threshold). In observe mode quarantine does not skip redirects — this is a forecast of enforce behavior, not 'bad redirects saved'.

panels.title: Verify RTT (success mean)
panels.description: Mean open_verify RTT for successes only. See failure mean and Verify RTT chart.

panels.title: Verify RTT (failure mean)
panels.description: Mean open_verify RTT for failures. Often near VERIFY_TIMEOUT when timeouts dominate.

panels.title: Positive cache hit ratio
panels.description: hit_positive / all lookups. See Negative cache hit ratio for known-bad hits.

panels.title: Negative cache hit ratio
panels.description: hit_negative / all lookups. Known-bad cache; in observe the redirect is still returned; in enforce it drives tried= retry.

panels.title: Queue admissions
panels.description: Leaders entering the FIFO: admitted got a slot; queue_timeout / queue_full never ran open_verify. queue_timeout rate is the capacity signal (admitted wait mean is usually ~0 and omitted).

panels.title: Verify RTT (mean)
panels.description: open_verify wall time after FIFO admission (leaders that ran verify). success/failure are real verify outcomes — FIFO rejects are not here (see Queue admissions). Failure mean often sits near VERIFY_TIMEOUT when timeouts dominate; that is still a useful signal.

panels.title: Cache path mix
panels.description: Rate of openverify cache lookups by result. hit_positive skips live verify; miss drives verify; hit_negative is a known-bad cache entry (tried= retry only in enforce mode; in observe the redirect is still returned).

panels.title: Verify outcomes
panels.description: Rate of actual open_verify runs by success/failure (excludes FIFO queue rejects).

panels.title: OpenVerify time penalty (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: OV hop latency quantiles across all outcomes. Spikes near QUEUE_TIMEOUT / VERIFY_TIMEOUT are often rejects or timed-out verifies — filter the delay heatmap by outcome for path split.

panels.title: OpenVerify redirect delay (histogram)
panels.description: Distribution of wall time from SFS_REDIRECT until accept/retry. Filter with Delay outcome: verify_* = actual open_verify; queue_timeout/queue_full = FIFO reject (never verified); cache_hit_*; avoided = quarantine skip (enforce). Does not include cmsd stalls.

panels.title: Site EWMA health (higher = worse)
panels.description: EWMA badness (higher = worse). topk(15) membership can change over time (legend flicker). Updates in observe and enforce; only enforce skips via tried=.

panels.title: Sites → error types (rate)
panels.description: Verify failure reasons by locate source (rucio vs cmsd) for selected Site(s). Requires plugin with source label on verify_failures_total.

panels.title: Error types → sites (rate)
panels.description: Pick Error reason(s) above to see which sites contribute. Uses $site and $reason filters.

panels.title: cmsd stall duration (histogram)
panels.description: Distribution of cmsd SFS_STALL seconds passed to the client. Buckets: ≤1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, +Inf.

panels.title: Site × error heatmap (avg rate in range)
panels.description: Average verify-failure rate over the dashboard time range (not a timeseries). Rows = site, columns = error reason, cell = avg ops/s. Darker/redder = more problems. Uses rate([...$__range]) so the whole window is one average.

panels.title: Verify failures: source × site × error (counts in range)
panels.description: Long-form counts (increase over the dashboard time range) with locate source (rucio vs cmsd). Sort by Count. For a site×error matrix colored by average rate, see the heatmap panel above.

panels.title: Site status (scores)
panels.description: Per-site EWMA / healthy flag / verify outcomes over the dashboard time range. healthy=0 can appear in observe without redirects being skipped.

panels.title: Avoided / s (total)
panels.description: Quarantine + negative-cache skips via tried=. ~0 when avoidance is inactive (observe).

panels.title: Avoidance rate
panels.description: Avoided / handled. ~0 when avoidance is inactive (observe).

panels.title: Exhausted / s
panels.description: Opens that hit the cmsd attempt budget without verify success. ~0 when retries are inactive (observe).

panels.title: Accept attempt mix (range)
panels.description: Share of accepted opens (any path) that needed a 2nd+ replica/candidate within that path.

panels.title: Rucio multi-replica share (range)
panels.description: Share of Rucio-path accepts where verify succeeded on replica 2+ (range). Observe ~0.

panels.title: cmsd retry share (range)
panels.description: Share of cmsd-accepted opens that needed attempt 2+ (range). Observe stays near 0.

panels.title: Bad redirects saved / s
panels.description: Quarantine / negative-cache skips via tried=. ~0 when avoidance is inactive (observe).

panels.title: Rucio verify success by replica
panels.description: Verify succeeded on the Nth ordered Rucio replica (attempt label). 5+ = success on replica 5 or later — not fallthrough. exhausted = PFNs returned but none accepted (rucio_exhausted_total); separate from soft-fail.

panels.title: cmsd accept rate by attempt
panels.description: Rate of opens accepted on the Nth cmsd redirect candidate (1/2/3), plus cmsd budget exhausted.

panels.title: Rucio path share
panels.description: Share of accepted opens that used a verified Rucio PFN (vs cmsd path). ~0 when Rucio is off.

panels.title: Rucio-path accepts / s
panels.description: Accepted opens whose redirect came from the Rucio-first path.

panels.title: cmsd-path accepts / s
panels.description: Accepted opens whose redirect came from cmsd / base OFS (Rucio off, soft-fail, or all Rucio candidates failed).

panels.title: Rucio lookups ok / s
panels.description: Successful list_replicas responses that returned at least one PFN.

panels.title: Rucio soft-fail / s
panels.description: Soft-fail to cmsd: empty (no replicas), auth_error, timeout, or error. Does not include ok-but-no-PFN-accepted (see Rucio exhausted).

panels.title: Rucio exhausted / s
panels.description: Lookup returned PFNs but none accepted (verify fail / negative cache / quarantine / tried=). Fall through to cmsd. With soft-fail: cmsd-path accepts ≤ soft-fail + exhausted. Requires plugin with rucio_exhausted_total; re-import this dashboard if the panel is missing.

panels.title: PFNs / ok lookup
panels.description: Average Rucio PFN candidates returned per successful lookup.

panels.title: Accepted opens by locate path
panels.description: Which path supplied the accepted redirect: rucio (verified Rucio PFN) vs cmsd (base OFS, including after Rucio soft-fail or all Rucio candidates failed). Not destination site.

panels.title: Rucio lookups by result
panels.description: ok = candidates returned; empty/auth_error/timeout/error = soft-fail to cmsd.

panels.title: Rucio locate mean
panels.description: Mean wall time of one Rucio list_replicas call (auth+HTTP). Not verify time.

panels.title: cmsd locate mean
panels.description: Mean wall time of one wrapped OFS open/select (cmsd Finder). Includes stall wait only if OFS blocks; SFS_STALL return is timed until return.

panels.title: Locate RTT mean (rucio vs cmsd)
panels.description: Mean locate wall time by source. Rucio = list_replicas; cmsd = m_wrapped->open select. Excludes open_verify.

panels.title: Locate RTT histogram (rucio)
panels.description: Distribution of Rucio list_replicas wall times.

panels.title: Locate RTT histogram (cmsd)
panels.description: Distribution of cmsd/OFS open-select wall times.

panels.title: cmsd after Rucio exhaust (host compare)
panels.description: Diagnostic only: of recovered opens (cmsd OK after Rucio exhaust), whether cmsd host was in the Rucio PFN list. Prefer "Rucio exhaust → cmsd OK" / recovery ratio for the real signal. Sum of series equals rucio_exhausted_recovered_total rate.

panels.title: Rucio exhaust → cmsd OK / s
panels.description: cmsd openverify accepted after every Rucio PFN failed/was skipped. Primary recovery count (excludes soft-fail→cmsd). Requires rucio_exhausted_recovered_total.

panels.title: Exhaust recovery ratio
panels.description: recovered / exhausted: fraction of Rucio-exhaust opens where cmsd openverify then succeeded.

title: CMS XRootD OpenVerify
description: CMS global redirector ops: AAA baseline, OpenVerify health/verify/sites, avoidance & retries, Rucio-first, locate latency.
